segments.name: holistic vision care
segments.description: Sells eyewear, contacts and eye exams directly to consumers through its retail stores and e-commerce platform as an integrated vision care brand.
segments.evidence: The holistic vision care segment sells eyewear products and provides optical services directly to customers through its retail and e-commerce platform.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay Warby Parker directly for eyewear, contacts and eye exams through its stores and website, with insurance reimbursing some vision care purchases.
revenueModel.evidence: We design our glasses in-house at our New York City headquarters and sell directly to customers, enabling us to make high-quality, designer eyewear more accessible, with simple, unified pricing starting at $95 including prescription lenses.
